# gitea_repository_tag (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of a specific tag in a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_tag" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
  name = "v1.0.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `commit_sha` (String) Commit SHA of the tag
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String) Tag message
